{"reason": "Removed the suggest-alternative-supplier branch: alt supplier (45000) is dominated by alert-planner (35000, always on time). Widened the expedite gate to medium+ risk under 9 days, fixing the stockout rows (medium 2.8d/5.3d where alt lead 4/7 arrived late, cost 195000) while monitoring high-inventory rows (10-13.2d, regular-lead <=8) for free.", "source": "(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium)) (< inventory-days 9))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
